notes.title: “Work out your salvation with fear and trembling”
notes.intro: Paul urges believers to work out their salvation, “for it is God who works in you.”

views.label: Living out a salvation already given
views.summary: Protestants read this as living out the salvation already received, with God doing the work within.

views.label: Cooperating with grace in a lifelong process
views.summary: Catholic, Orthodox and Methodist Christians see here human cooperation with God’s grace in growing holiness.
views.source: Catechism of the Catholic Church 2001–2002; John Wesley, sermon “On Working Out Our Own Salvation” (1785)
